title: Spin in randomized clinical trials evaluating quality of life after third molar extraction: a meta-research study
html: The aim of this study was to evaluate the prevalence of spin and associated factors in randomized controlled trials (RCTs) assessing quality of life after third molar extraction. This meta-research followed meta-epidemiological guidelines and included RCTs reporting quality of life outcomes after third molar surgery, regardless of statistical significance. Searches were conducted in 11 databases up to March 2025. Spin was assessed in abstracts, main texts, and conclusions, and categorized as low (<25%), moderate (25–75%), or high (>75%).
